item.text:
The design lists three samples per condition: S1–S3 as control and S4–S6 as treated. The matching replicate numbers across conditions do not, by themselves, show that samples are paired. The current design has no pairing or batch factor, so a differential expression comparison would treat the groups as independent and compare treated against control. If those samples are actually matched or batch effects matter, that structure is not captured here.
